title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Analyze customer loyalty and other sales scenarios
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces new Power BI reports on customer loyalty and analysis views for sales orders, along with subtotals in Excel-based sales reports and enhanced demo data. These features help sales and finance teams understand customer trends and manage pipelines more effectively.
key_points: New Power BI reports (Customer Retention Overview and Customer Retention History) track customer loyalty patterns
Built-in sales reports now include subtotals in Excel layouts to reduce manual calculation work
Analysis views on Sales Order List provide insights into expected sales volume, customer demand, and aged accounts
Enhanced demo sales data enables more realistic testing and training scenarios
